name: Kathryn Drysdale
bio: Kathryn Drysdale is an English actress who started her career in 1999 on the TV series People Like Us. She's known for her roles in the BBC sitcom Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps and the films Vanity Fair and St Trinian's. She's also had recurring roles in Lloyd of the Flies, Circle Square, Dennis & Gnasher: Unleashed, The Windsors, Bottersnikes & Gumbles, and Benidorm.
